This feature is best implemented as a tight integration into the engine, especially relating to import and final output.

# Limitations

1) Because color primaries are not stored in `Color` values, it will become impossible to share colors between projects without those projects both being configured to use the same color primaries.
2) Runtime texture loading may become more complex, as color primary conversion may be necessary.
3) Color constants in Godot may be challenging to turn into something that is dynamic based on the current color primaries.
answers.workaround: No, changing color primaries requires modification of the output (blit) shader at minimum.
